hook.description: The clip opens within 0-2200ms on Juliana crying out her defiance, and her line 'Because I am right!' at 200-2400ms grabs attention immediately. The opening lacks any stated stakes, so the hook is strong on emotion but thin on context.

cliffhanger.description: In the final 3000ms, the glowing iron stops millimeters from Juliana's right eye (E116, 28400-31580ms), and the extreme close-up holds on her eye as the frame cuts to black (E117, 29200-31580ms). Nothing in the clip shows whether the iron touches her, so the tension is unresolved at the end.

promos.why_it_works: Escalating defiance and rage culminate in a glowing iron stopping millimeters from Juliana's eye, cut to black before any outcome is shown.
warnings: A first-time viewer cannot tell who the characters are or why they are in conflict
Opening line 'Because I am right!' lacks a stated subject, weakening early clarity
The title and power dispute in the dialogue is not anchored to visible events
Cliffhanger depends on prior unexplained stakes for full impact
Several camera descriptions repeat the same tension beat, slowing the escalation in the middle section
Identities and relationship of Catherine and Juliana are never established
The reason for the imprisonment and chains is not explained

'Because I am right!' in E95 has no stated subject or prior claim
